headline: Oil Prices and Energy Funds Fall as US-Iran Talks Ease War Premium
summary: Oil prices dropped as Washington and Tehran signaled talks, easing geopolitical war premiums. The USO oil fund fell 7.08%, while shares of Petrobras declined 4.04%, YPF dropped 6.7%, and Ecopetrol fell 5.93%.
why: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East often introduce a risk premium into crude oil prices. Diplomatic signals reducing supply disruption fears cause rapid downward repricing in energy assets.

impacts.name: Crude oil
impacts.why: Diplomatic signals between the US and Iran eased war risk premiums embedded in oil.
